description: Offshore Renewable Energy Infrastructure Regions is a dataset listed in Victorian Government Data Directory (discover.data.vic.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of Energy, Environment and Climate Action. The Offshore Renewable Energy Infrastructure Regions is a digital dataset that contains reference areas of proposed and declared areas suitable for offshore renewable energy established under legislation. In the event of an inconsistency between this data and the legislation, the latter prevails. Coverage: Victoria. The portal files it under the publisher Department of Energy, Environment and Climate Action. Its tags are Oceans. It offers 7 resource(s) in dwg, dxf, extended tab, gdb, mif. The portal shows 2026-07-30 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-au-vic-portal.
